caption:
Me sneaking to the kitchen without a sound

Me sneaking to the kitchen without a sound.

The floor always knows. Walk close to the wall, where the boards are nailed down tighter, and it creaks less.

Send it to the friend who raids the kitchen at midnight.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A dark bedroom. A small amber block figure with white eyes tiptoes to the right in tiny slow steps, swaying side to side, with narrowed eyes. Near the end its eyes turn happy as if it made it. In the last second the text changes from: me sneaking to the kitchen without a sound, to: the floor: creak. The figure freezes with wide eyes and trembles, then narrows its eyes at the camera.
